decode_layout: 1 byte total. offset 0, len 1: u8 flag decoded as `should_panic: bool` using canonical bool encoding (0x01 => true, any other value including 0x00 => false). Trailing bytes are ignored. Empty input (len < 1) short-circuits to an empty output Vec without touching the code under test. Output: u32 little-endian, 4 bytes (7 on the non-panicking path; on the panicking path the guest aborts and sets panic=true, as in the original program).
